newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia extends easy loans to palm oil refiners.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia extends easy loans to palm oil refiners.

text.p: Malaysia said on Thursday that it was extending easy government loans to palm oil refiners to upgrade technology.

The Ministry for International Trade and Industry (MITI) said the Industrial Adjustment Fund's coverage was being widened to include palm oil refiners so they can change from thermal heating oils (THO) to high pressure steam (HPO) technology.

"The maximum amount of soft loans available for each eligible refining company is 1.5 million ringgit with an interest rate of 7.75 percent per annum," MITI's Minister Rafidah Aziz said at an annual dialogue with the industry.
In addition, refining companies can also apply for an Industrial Adjustment Allowance for the same capital expenditure involved in the conversion from THO to HPS, she said.

A MITI statement said the technology change was to comply with the requirements of the European Commission's Seed Crushers and Oil Processors Federation (Fedoil) and Codex Revised Draft Recommended Code of Practice for Storage.
It said that out of 41 refining companies, 20 were still using the THO system, eight had converted partially and only 13 had completely changed to the HPS system.
